_doc: Targets for the recurring supply-chain-gated update lane. gate=auto-upgrade-if-SAFE (human policy 2026-06-27). See scripts/linuxbox/safe-update-check.sh and CLAUDE.md > Update gate.

targets.name: hermes

targets.name: mem-constant

targets.name: claude-mem
targets.notes: No version_cmd: npx @latest would download/hang on the 2GB box. Gate relies on npm-registry latest + OSV.
